# Run verdict v2 golden fixture

## Contract

Production Readiness v2 has 17 required sub-scores. A composite, letter grade,
and deployment signal exist only when all 17 are available. Dimension weights
are fixed at `25/85`, `20/85`, `20/85`, and `20/85`; they are never reweighted
from a run's availability mask. Planned Alpha Calibration metrics have zero
weight until a future scorer version.

## Provenance

- Product definition:
  `docs/references/reconciliations/engine-lab-runs-75-76-statistics-validation-plan.md`
  section “Replace dynamic readiness reweighting with a fixed completeness
  contract”.
- Observed incomplete cells: the metric inputs displayed for Engine Lab Python
  run 77 and LEAN sidecar run 78. LEAN-native fields are included as hostile
  sentinels and must not change platform readiness coverage or scoring.
- Complete cell: a hand-authored 17/17 platform-canonical contract using the
  run-77 values where they exist. This cell proves fixed weights and grading
  without treating either engine's output as its own oracle.
- Expected sub-score buckets and composites were calculated by hand from the
  published thresholds in `app/services/run_verdict_service.py`. The fixture
  was not generated by the implementation under test.

## Validation

```text
python -m pytest tests/services/test_run_verdict_parity.py
```

The fixture is immutable for verdict version 2. A policy change requires a new
versioned directory rather than editing these expected values.
